artifacts.rights_basis: Guéranger died in 1875 and the named translator, Laurence Shepherd, in 1885, and the volume was published in 1910, so it is in the United States public domain by publication date and no life-based term reaches it. The Internet Archive/Google scan is a mechanical facsimile of that public-domain printing and adds no human authorship (Bridgeman Art Library v. Corel Corp., 36 F. Supp. 2d 191 (S.D.N.Y. 1999)); no separate creative copyright claim is relied upon and no host rights label is relied upon.

work.author: Prosper Guéranger and continuators
work.description: The historical and theological commentary on the Roman liturgical year begun by Prosper Guéranger and continued after his death. English editions translate the French series; the registered Time after Pentecost II volume identifies itself as a Continuation without naming its writer in the checked preface. Its interpretations are reception witnesses rather than promulgating liturgical sources.
work.title: The Liturgical Year
